notes.title: Patch 4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Nicer item found in some chests
[*] Additional spawn points in the wild outside Bytesville (to help avoid respawning back in far locations after death)
[*] Extra ammo pickup in final sector
[*] NPCs random dialog is now unique for each NPC within each level load
[*] Less tiling in the mountain terrain
[*] Removed a pitch black corridor dead-end from the cave and improved launcher angle
[*] Added moving platforms down from some platformers
[*] Little Jed now talks and other conversation lore tweaks
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Corrected some terrain anomalies
[*] Fixed ledge climbing above shops that sometimes teleported the player
[*] Containers would sometimes regenerate taken items
[*] Weapon change key bindings added to options menu
[*] Initial gun/throwable selection after game load did not show ammo
[*] Moved an arch higher in Bitsville (so can walk underneath it)
[*] Removed some bad phone lines in Bitsville
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Made two columns wider in the Black Obelisk platformer (to help initiate a sprint before jumping and landing)
[*] Agents in Bitsville and the oasis do not respawn after complete destruction (Bytesville ones still do after leaving the wider area or going to main menu)
[*] Added a signpost to "The Black Door" outside Bitsville
[*] Added additional spawn points in the Bytesville hills to help avoid spawn "spoilers"
[*] Zero key now causes damage to the player so can respawn if stuck without having to go back to the main menu
[*] Now hides buttons in main menu and shows a loading pop-up widget while the world is loading
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased sound attenuation of NPC footsteps (less loud)
[*] "Start New Game" button no longer gives a "Confirm delete game" prompt when playing for the first time (and "Continue" button is invisible)
[*] Tweaked NPC animations to improve performance and help prevent an occasional shaking gliche
[*] Removed a floating crate from Bitsville
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Increased weapon change speed by 100%
[*] Added platformer in Bitsville central square
[*] Tweaked bride "return message" quest text
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added nav mesh bounds to the Bytesville lake to stop Bill becoming a submariner
[*] Raised some below waterline terrain near the cave (causes splash sounds)
[*] Turned off house edge climbing in Bitsville as it could push you inside the house mesh
[*] Removed some floating containers from Bitsville
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Weapon hot keys added: 1:Fist, 2:Axe, 3:Pickaxe, 4:SMG, 5:AK47, 6:Grenades, 7:Rocks
[*] Now using "Talk to {name}" for NPC interactions rather than just "Talk"
[*] Extra information about where people live in quest details return text (In Quest Gui via TAB key)
[*] Chests under water on more horizontal surfaces and one is nearer to keys to draw attention to it
[*] Extra Jed line and NPC line about the first key location
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Throwable count not always clearing when Axe/Pickaxe is selected
[*] Ensure upper body yaw and pitch are zero when entering a ladder
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could start to move away from the ladder with continuous ascent and descent
[*] Fixed a couple of floating trees next to the church
[*] Stopped the small dragons from sometimes purring after death
[/list]
